registered: 2026-11-14, before any timed run of this experiment (correctness runs on the laptop preceded registration and are correctness-only)
recording: not recorded by the team runtime; self-recorded manifests; monolithic's runtime gate satisfied by the local stand-in used since the paired experiment
host: cuda5.cims.nyu.edu, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (sm_89), CUDA 12.6; all builds from code/build_variants.sh (each variant from its own commit; version 1 from eef8302)

correctness_gate.content: for v1 and v2-1..v2-5 (+ v2-5 on the cap-400,000 index): fixture suite with each build's feature flags; 100K and 1M documents x 500 queries at k=10 and 100 (v1) or k=10, 100 and 1000 (variants), each saved top-k compared with cpu_pilot oracles; adapted monolithic 1M x 500 at k=10 and k=100 with --verify 1
correctness_gate.variant_4_5_counter: the merge counter is zeroed with cudaMemset after allocation in every process and re-armed by the merging block; each gate process runs 2 passes x 500 queries and timing processes 23 x 500, and any query after a missed reset would return no merged winners, so every process's exact match is the empirical check
correctness_gate.rule: any mismatch or failure stops before timing and is reported

timing_common.order: rotating: in round p implementation (i + offset_p) mod n runs i-th, offsets 0, ceil(n/3), ceil(2n/3)
timing_common.boundary_range: host build of the query, query transfer (H2D copy for v1..v2-3, kernel argument for v2-4/v2-5), all kernels, top-k D2H, event synchronisation; index/rank setup excluded
timing_common.gpu_check: wait for no compute process before each process (poll 60 s, abort after 60 min); 2-second GPU process sampler with other users' paths redacted
timing_common.correctness_during_timing: every saved top-k of every process compared with the CPU oracle; monolithic's own post-timing validation must succeed
timing_common.analysis: analysis/analyze_v2.py: per-process query medians over 20 measured rounds; geometric mean of 1,500 paired query/process ratios; 10,000-draw crossed query/process bootstrap, seed 20261116; pooled descriptive medians

2a_k10.contrasts: each variant / v1; each range implementation / mono; incremental steps v2-1/v1, v2-2/v2-1, v2-3/v2-2, v2-4/v2-3, v2-5/v2-4, v2-5cap/v2-5

runs.best_variant_rule: the variant among v2-1..v2-5 (uniform ranges) with the lowest geometric-mean ratio to v1 at k=10; if two intervals overlap, still the lower point estimate, and the overlap is reported
runs.cap_helped_rule: the cap helped if the upper end of the v2-5cap / v2-5 interval is below 1

2c_k1000.note: v1 and monolithic support k <= 128, so k=1000 is a single-implementation descriptive result

3_sweep_k10.implementations: best at uniform range sizes W = 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384 (+ best on the cap-400,000 index at W=4096 if the cap helped), and v1 at W=4096
3_sweep_k10.indexes: built with the best variant's own range_bitpack_tool from hash-1000000.gsp in its encoding
3_sweep_k10.contrasts: each W / v1, each W / best at W=4096
3_sweep_k10.per_W: latency (paired ratio and pooled median), index posting bytes, range count, and waves = ranges / (resident blocks per SM x SMs) from code/occupancy.sh (Nsight Compute launch metrics, one query, run after timing)

phase_b_specs: configs/timing-k100.tsv, timing-k1000.tsv and timing-sweep.tsv are written from the rules above after 2a's analysis and committed before they run
not_in_this_registration: held-out queries, batch > 1, other GPUs, pruning
